title: Proverbial and Figurative Manner Frames
goal: Use figurative *como* and *según* frames alongside indicative and subjunctive manner clauses.

items: I can use proverbial and figurative manner frames such as *como anillo al dedo* and *como quien no quiere la cosa*.
I can contrast indicative for known manner with subjunctive for open manner after *como* and *según*.
I can distinguish literal from figurative interpretations in context.
